provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks the place or state something separates from, with intransitive verbs of departure and exit (家を出る, バスを降りる) and with 卒業する (大学を卒業する). Two sibling entries take the other readings: the direct object acted on (本を読む) and the route travelled (道を歩く, 橋を渡る). から is usually available with the motion verbs (家から出る, バスから降りる), but 大学を卒業する has no から counterpart.

examples.ruby: 兄[あに]は毎朝[まいあさ]六時[ろくじ]に家[いえ]を出[で]て走[はし]っている。
examples.english: My brother leaves the house at six every morning and goes running.

examples.ruby: 次[つぎ]の角[かど]でバスを降[お]りたほうが近道[ちかみち]だよ。
examples.english: You're better off getting off the bus at the next corner; it's a shortcut.

examples.ruby: 姉[あね]は去年[きょねん]大学[だいがく]を卒業[そつぎょう]して働[はたら]いている。
examples.english: My sister graduated from university last year and is working now.
